$comment: Generic MCP client config (the mcpServers shape most clients accept: Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, custom agents). HOSTED entries need no install. LOCAL entry runs this package's MCP server — replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH with your clone path (after: npm install && npm run build). Once the package is published to npm, the local entry can instead be: { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "--package=@openclawd/clawd-connectors", "clawd-connectors-mcp"] } — it is NOT on npm yet (checked 2026-11-27).
